title: Senior Manager, Partner Solution Architect
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  
  

As Senior Manager, Partner Solution Architects, you will lead and grow a team of Partner Success Architects (PSAs) based in our India Delivery Center, setting the technical direction, delivery standards, and career development path for the team. Your team is the technical backbone of our partner ecosystem, providing hands-on solution design, activation support, and delivery escalation expertise for our global network of Systems Integrator (SI) and Independent Software Vendor (ISV) Global Delivery Center personnel as Docusign’s in-region APJ partners. You will work cross-functionally with Americas, EMEA and AP partner and sales leadership, engineering, and the global Partner Success organization to make sure the right technical resources are deployed against the right priorities, and that every technical engagement ties back to a tangible, customer-facing partner deliverable.

This position is a people manager role reporting to the Senior Director, Value Delivery Activation.

**Responsibility**

* Lead, hire, coach, and develop a team of Partner Solution Architects in the India Delivery Center, setting technical quality standards, career paths, and performance expectations
* Own technical solutioning and technical delivery support for Docusign's APJ in-region teams, ensuring PSAs deliver timely, high-quality solution design, activation workshops, and delivery escalation support for partner-led engagements
* Own technical solutioning and technical delivery support for GDC resources across our Systems Integrator (SI) and Independent Software Vendor (ISV) network.
* Partner closely with in-region Partner Success and Sales leaders to align on ISV and SI enablement and delivery-support priorities, and ensure PSA resources are deployed in alignment with in-region business strategies and demand
* Define, document, and continuously refine team activities, engagement models, and playbooks, ensuring technical solutioning and technical delivery support connect directly to customer-facing partner deliverables
* Establish and report on agreed upon team KPIs (e.g., GDC pre-delivery assessment completion, nearshore delivery volume, GDC-to-onshore handoff SLAs, ISV/Builder enablement and activation velocity) to global Customer Success and Partner Success leadership
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues raised by partner personnel, engaging Docusign engineering and product teams as needed
* Represent the Partner Success Architect function to internal stakeholders and partner organizations, championing consistent, scalable technical enablement practices

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  
  

**Basic**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12+ years of experience in technical solutioning, solutions architecture, or technical delivery roles, including experience supporting partner or channel ecosystems
* 2+ years of people management experience, ideally leading technical or partner-facing teams
* Demonstrated experience working with Systems Integrators (SI) and/or Independent Software Vendors (ISV)
* Experience supporting or collaborating with global and regional delivery teams across time zones, including APJ

  
  

**Preferred**

* Experience building, managing, or scaling a Global Delivery Center (GDC) or nearshore/offshore technical delivery model
* Hands-on experience with Docusign IAM, CLM, eSignature, or agentic/AI-native solutions
* Experience with Salesforce.com
* Experience defining enablement programs, technical playbooks, or delivery frameworks for partner ecosystems
* Track record of aligning cross-regional stakeholders (APJ, EMEA, Americas) on shared technical enablement and delivery priorities
* Strong understanding of e-signature, contract lifecycle management (CLM), or intelligent agreement management technologies
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to both technical and business audiences

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

title: Academic Success Manager India
description:

You will be expected to work with leading educational institutions to create lasting partnerships that make AVEVA’s portfolio easily accessible and commercially affordable.

* Build and foster relationships with academic institutions by presenting AVEVA’s offerings and endorse them by embedding our software into the university’s curriculums
* Demonstrating the ability to improve existing engagements with the academia by driving adoption of existing and new AVEVA solutions
* Gathering and researching information to solve academia inquiries by using internal tools and escalation within teams as necessary

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive program progress against goals and objectives by establishing logistics, like marketing materials, participation in, or sponsorship of related events

* Experience defining, developing and leading complex projects in a fast-paced, changing environment

* Experience in communicating with cross functional international teams
* Academic background or experience working with the academic community

**Knowledge & Experience Required**

  

* You will have 7-9 years of experience in the industrial software world
* You will have significant experience with engineering solutions within the industrial marketplace
* You will be a self-starter, optimising and enhancing the universities education programs/curriculum by familiarizing them with our solutions
* You will be able to manage and provide direction and be able to work effectively with our academic partners
* You will have sound commercial and business development skills to define and quantify a suitable delivery strategy
* You will have a good understanding of the scope of the current products and service offerings from AVEVA
* You will have a deep knowledge of the business processes, information flow and management practices for the marketplace

From industry experts and solution architects to sales, support, success managers, and business operations, everyone shares a common goal: to deeply understand our customers' needs and deliver tailored solutions.

If you're passionate about driving growth, tackling complex business challenges, and fostering strong customer relationships, you'll find success and fulfilment in our Commercial team.

You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

title: Senior AI Solutions Architect
description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
Job Profile Summary
  
  
The Senior AI Solutions Architect is an advanced subject matter expert responsible for shaping, validating and assuring complex artificial intelligence solutions during the opportunity-to-order lifecycle.
  
  
The role operates as the primary technical and delivery interlock between regional go-to-market teams and the Global AI Delivery Unit. It enables sellers and regional solution teams to access AI delivery expertise without requiring core delivery resources to become extensively engaged in routine pre-sales activity.
  
  
The Senior AI Solutions Architect works with clients, sales teams, solution teams, commercial management, delivery leaders and specialist technical teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, commercially viable and delivery-ready AI solutions.
  
  
The role contributes to, or leads, the development of solution architectures, prototypes and proofs of concept where required. It validates solution feasibility, delivery scope, resource requirements, effort estimates, commercial assumptions, delivery risks and contractual commitments before NTT DATA enters into a client agreement.
  
  
As part of the Global AI Delivery Unit, the role helps protect delivery outcomes and the AI Delivery PL by ensuring that proposed solutions have an appropriate delivery structure, cost-recovery model, risk position and transition plan before customer signature.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Deal intake and GTM interlock
  

* Act as the primary technical and delivery interlock for assigned AI opportunities from qualified intake through solution approval, contracting and handover to delivery.
* Engage with regional GTM, sales and solution teams early in the opportunity lifecycle to understand the client’s business problem, intended outcomes, technical environment, data landscape and commercial requirements.
* Assess whether the opportunity is sufficiently qualified for Global AI Delivery engagement and identify any additional information, discovery or customer validation required.
* Review use-case descriptions and business requirements to assess whether the proposed use of AI is appropriate, feasible and aligned with measurable client outcomes.
* Support structured discovery sessions with clients and internal stakeholders, translating business requirements into actionable technical and delivery requirements.
* Identify the specialist capabilities required to support the pursuit and coordinate targeted engagement from Global AI Delivery Unit, security, legal, commercial and regional delivery teams.
* Manage the involvement of delivery specialists carefully, ensuring that delivery expertise is used for material design decisions and specialist validation without drawing delivery teams unnecessarily into general pre-sales activity.
* Maintain clear communication with opportunity owners regarding solution status, outstanding decisions, risks, dependencies and readiness for assurance.

AI solution architecture and design
  

* Shape or own the end-to-end architecture of AI solutions across application, model, data, integration, infrastructure and security domains.
* Evaluate architecture options and select appropriate AI models, cloud services, orchestration frameworks and third-party technologies, balancing cost, performance, scalability, security and delivery complexity.
* Define secure integration, functional and non-functional requirements, data governance and responsible AI requirements for the proposed solution.
* Align solutions with NTT DATA reference architectures, reusable assets, delivery patterns and approved technology standards.

description:
**Date posted** 10/11/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19196****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/11/2026**

**Vulnerability Management Analyst - Semiconductor IP**

**We Are:**

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

**You Are:**

You are someone who builds trust with product and engineering teams when the topic is risk. You listen first, explain complex findings in clear language, and own your conclusions. You help people understand what a vulnerability means for their work and what they should do next.

You are practical when information is incomplete. You stay focused on timely action, challenge unclear choices in a respectful way, and keep looking for better ways to reduce risk. You care about teamwork, follow-through, and leaving guidance that others can use.

This is a full-time role.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Analyze vulnerabilities affecting semiconductor IP products, firmware, and related interfaces, and determine residual risk with clear assumptions.
* Prioritize findings so product teams can act in a timely way: severity, exploitability, affected assets, and recommended mitigations.
* Work with design, verification, firmware, and product teams to explain vulnerabilities, walk through impact, and agree how the team will mitigate.
* Advise those teams on practical mitigations, compensating controls, and verification or test evidence that shows the risk is reduced.
* Work in semiconductor IP development and associated test flows, using the tools those teams use to design, verify, and test IP, so analysis matches how the product is actually built.
* Build and maintain your own analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting tools, including in Python, when existing tools are not enough. Scripts and tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Track open risk through the cybersecurity lifecycle, from intake through analysis, treatment, verification, and internal release decisions, and keep status current.
* Facilitate working sessions so similar IP classes get consistent analysis, risk language, and mitigation guidance.
* Look for new and practical ways to detect, assess, and mitigate risk, including improved methods, automation, and lessons from prior findings.
* Use agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) to speed research and first drafts without handing off ownership of risk conclusions.
* Run the job in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track vulnerability and risk work, keep documentation current, and version work products through review.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Give product teams vulnerability analysis and risk determinations they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
* Reduce time-to-mitigation by explaining findings clearly and agreeing practical next steps with the teams that own the product.
* Leave mitigation and test guidance that design, verification, and firmware teams can execute.
* Keep residual risk visible and current so internal release and treatment decisions are based on evidence, not stale status.
* Improve consistency of vulnerability handling and risk language across similar IP classes.
* Raise the quality of risk reduction over time by bringing new methods, better mitigations, and fit-for-purpose tools into the workflow.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
* Typically 3 or more years in vulnerability management, product cybersecurity, embedded security, or a closely related engineering role. Stronger evidence on vulnerability analysis and risk determination can offset fewer years. Title (Analyst or Senior Analyst) will match demonstrated depth.
* Strong practical experience in vulnerability analysis on real products, not only scanning or training exercises.
* Ability to determine risk: severity, exploitability, affected assets, likelihood, impact, and residual risk after proposed mitigations.
* Ability to explain vulnerabilities and recommended mitigations to engineering teams so they can act in a timelyway.
* Working familiarity with semiconductor IP development and associated testing, including the tools used to design, verify, and test IP. Specific commercial tool names are not required.
* Ability to write and maintain your own tools, including in Python, for analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting when existing tools are not enough. This is not a software-engineering role. Tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Experience working with incomplete information and stating assumptions when the end-system is not fully known.
Experience* ing a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, design, implementation, verification, and internal release, including tracking open risk to closure.
* Hands-on understanding of embedded systems enough to reason about hardware-rooted and firmware vulnerabilities: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, interfaces, registers, boot and debug, and interconnects.
* Experience delivering analysis inside product-team cadence, including re-prioritizing when new findings or design changes arrive.
* Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.

* Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions with geographically distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of common vulnerability scoring and handling practice (for example CVSS) is helpful, as is ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard, digital design or verification background (including RTL), semiconductor IP product experience, or applied embedded cryptography.

**Who You Are:**

* You build trust with design and product teams and keep working relationships strong when the discussion is about risk.
* You own the technical conclusion. You do not hand off judgment to a scanner, a score, a tool, or the loudest voice in the room.
* You write and speak clearly so engineers can understand a vulnerability and how to mitigate it without you in the room.
* You work well with incomplete information, and you state assumptions instead of hiding them.
* You drive timely action. You keep risk visible until it is treated or accepted with a clear rationale.
* You challenge unclear practices in a respectful way and recommend mitigations teams can actually adopt.
* You keep learning. You look for new and practical ways to assess and reduce risk, not only the methods you already know.
* You are collaborative and non-disruptive with product teams, including when you need them to change course.
* You are structured and detail-oriented, and you keep evidence current as findings and designs change.

**The Team You’ll Be** **A** **Part Of:**

You will join the CySec Vulnerability Management Team that supports Synopsys semiconductor IP products. You work with IP product teams in their delivery cadence. You collaborate with digital, analog, mixed-signal, firmware, and verification engineers, and with cybersecurity architects, to analyze vulnerabilities, determine risk, and agree mitigations through the cybersecurity lifecycle. The team works across regions. Your written work products are used by internal product and engineering teams.

**Rewards and Benefits:**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Senior Deployment Engineer
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**The Team**



Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business\-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business\-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI\-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go\-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long\-term success of our customers.


**The Role**



As a Senior Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands\-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI\-augmented workflows to deliver high\-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis's AI deployment tools as your primary instruments \- directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.



This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI\-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. **You generate value by understanding the customer's business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.**

  

**The Work You'll Do**


**Initiate and Connect**


* Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers' strategic objectives into high\-impact Celonis use cases
* Collaborate with the customer's IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
* Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required


**Build \& Value**


* Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards \- writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements
* Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI\-powered insights
* Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
* Validate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context \- applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
* Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
* Define and build KPIs measuring the customer's success and quantify business impact
* Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance


 **Rollout, Adoption, and Handover**


* Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long\-term adoption
* Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
* Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
* Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff


**Domain \& Industry Depth**


* Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
* Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
* Proactively identify and standardize high\-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap


**What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era**


* You work with AI agents as your primary tools \- your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually
* You need strong specification and context engineering skills \- the ability to translate a customer's ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
* You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
* You balance speed with quality \- AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
* You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable


**The Qualifications You Need**


* **Experience:** 4\+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. For Senior DE: 6\+ years with demonstrated project leadership.
* **Platform skills:** Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.
* **AI fluency:** Comfort working with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI\-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
* **Business and process domain expertise :** Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.
* **Consulting skills:** Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences.
* **Analytical mindset:** Excellent problem\-solving skills with a value\-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.
* **Learning agility:** Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.
* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.
* **Languages:** Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus.
* **Travel**: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

**What Celonis can offer you:**


* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI\-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full\-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit\-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work\-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

Job Title:  

* ASIC Verification\- Senior Staff Engineer

 At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. You Are:  

  

 You are an accomplished verification engineer with a passion for excellence and a track record of delivering robust, high\-quality IP solutions. You thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and are excited by the opportunity to work on next\-generation connectivity protocols that power commercial, enterprise, and automotive applications. With a solid foundation in Electrical/Electronics Engineering (BSEE with 8\+ years or MSEE with 6\+ years of relevant experience), you bring deep expertise in System Verilog and industry\-standard verification methodologies such as UVM/OVM/VMM. Your hands\-on experience developing HVL\-based test environments and extracting meaningful verification metrics sets you apart as a technical leader.  

  

 You are a collaborative team player who values knowledge sharing and actively contributes to a culture of continuous improvement. Your familiarity with protocols like MIPI\-I3C, UFS, AMBA, Ethernet, DDR, PCIe, and USB allows you to quickly ramp up on new projects and deliver results. You bring a strong analytical mindset, exceptional debugging skills, and a drive to meet and exceed quality metrics. Experienced with scripting languages like Perl, TCL, and Python, you automate processes for efficiency and scalability. Your strong communication skills, initiative, and global perspective enable you to work effectively with cross\-functional and multi\-site teams. Above all, you are a lifelong learner who embraces challenges, adapts to new technologies, and is committed to shaping the future of silicon design.

* Specify, architect, and implement advanced verification environments for DesignWare IP cores using System Verilog and state\-of\-the\-art methodologies.
* Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, ensuring coverage of unit\-level and system\-level requirements.
* Design, code, and debug testbenches, test cases, and functional coverage models to validate complex IP functionalities.
* Perform functional coverage analysis and manage regression testing to achieve and maintain required quality metrics.
* Collaborate closely with RTL designers and global verification teams to resolve issues and drive verification closure.
* Leverage scripting (Perl, TCL, Python) to automate verification flows, streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of verification methodologies, including VIP development and formal verification approaches.

  

The Impact You Will Have:  

* Ensure the delivery of high\-quality, robust IP cores that power critical applications in commercial, enterprise, and automotive markets.
* Drive innovation in verification methodologies, setting new standards for efficiency and coverage.
* Enhance time\-to\-market by identifying and resolving design and verification issues early in the development cycle.
* Strengthen Synopsys’ reputation as a leader in silicon IP and verification through technical excellence and customer focus.
* Mentor and support junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to the success of global, multi\-site R\&D teams by providing expertise and driving cross\-functional collaboration.

  

What You’ll Need:  

* BSEE with 8 years or MSEE with 6\+ years of relevant experience in ASIC or IP verification.
* Expertise in developing HVL (System Verilog)\-based verification environments and testbenches.

* Proficiency in verification methodologies such as UVM, OVM, or VMM; exposure to formal verification is highly desirable.
